headers.name: x-amz-cf-id
headers.source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/standard-logs-reference.html (x-edge-request-id, which CloudFront also sends in the x-amz-cf-id response header), and observed on 2026-11-06 on www.leboncoin.fr, api.leboncoin.fr, img.leboncoin.fr and sdk.privacy-center.org

headers.name: x-amz-cf-pop
headers.source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/functions-tutorial.html (example response), and observed on 2026-11-06 on www.leboncoin.fr, api.leboncoin.fr, img.leboncoin.fr and sdk.privacy-center.org

headers.name: via
headers.source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/RequestAndResponseBehaviorCustomOrigin.html (CloudFront sets Via to <http-version> <alphanumeric-string>.cloudfront.net (CloudFront) in the response to the viewer), and observed on 2026-11-06 on www.leboncoin.fr, api.leboncoin.fr, img.leboncoin.fr and sdk.privacy-center.org. The pattern lets a proxy closer to the browser append its own hop

headers.name: x-cache
headers.source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/functions-tutorial.html (FunctionGeneratedResponse from cloudfront, in the example response), and observed on 2026-11-06 on www.leboncoin.fr, api.leboncoin.fr, img.leboncoin.fr and sdk.privacy-center.org (Hit, Miss and Error from cloudfront)

server.source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/functions-tutorial.html (example of a response that CloudFront generates itself)

cname.source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/CreatingCNAME.html (a site's own name is a CNAME to the domain name of its distribution, such as d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net). A site whose DNS is Route 53 uses an alias record instead and shows no CNAME, as observed on 2026-11-06 on www.leboncoin.fr, api.leboncoin.fr and img.leboncoin.fr
